```{r}
    well_row = match(str_extract(Well_ID, "^[A-Z]"), LETTERS),
    well_column = as.integer(str_extract(Well_ID, "\\d+")),

  )

samplesheet <- samplesheet_auto %>%

plateID_to_folder_ID_fn <- "/vf/users/CARDPB2/iNDI/Production/metadata/indi_plateID_to_folderID.csv"

df <- read_parquet("/vf/users/kelpschdj/iNDI/Production/Organelle_segmentation/Panel_1/organelle_segmentation_AbPanel1.parquet")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
```

```{r}
#| label: Extract nucleus data

nuc_files <- list.files(
  path       = "/vf/users/kelpschdj/iNDI/Production/Nucleus_segmentation/Nucleus_feature_data/",
  pattern    = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

px_factor <- 0.09418670872212731
radius    <- 120
img_size  <- 2160

flag_size <- function(plate, min_um2 = 20, max_um2 = 200) {
  plate %>%
    mutate(
      area_um2  = area * px_factor^2,
      fail_size = area_um2 <= min_um2 | area_um2 >= max_um2
    )
}

flag_edge <- function(plate, radius = 120, img_h = img_size, img_w = img_size) {
  plate %>%
    mutate(
      fail_edge = `centroid-0` - radius < 0  |
                  `centroid-0` + radius > img_h |
                  `centroid-1` - radius < 0  |
                  `centroid-1` + radius > img_w
    )
}

flag_overlap_img <- function(df, radius = 120, max_overlap_frac = 0.05) {
  circle_area <- pi * radius^2
  max_overlap <- max_overlap_frac * circle_area

  cx   <- df$`centroid-1`
  cy   <- df$`centroid-0`
  n    <- nrow(df)
  fail <- logical(n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    dx          <- cx - cx[i]
    dy          <- cy - cy[i]
    d           <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
    neighbours  <- which(d > 0 & d < 2 * radius)

    if (length(neighbours) == 0) next

    overlaps <- sapply(neighbours, function(j) {
      dij <- d[j]
      2 * radius^2 * acos(dij / (2 * radius)) - (dij / 2) * sqrt(4 * radius^2 - dij^2)
    })

    if (any(overlaps > max_overlap)) fail[i] <- TRUE
  }

  df$fail_overlap <- fail
  df
}

flag_intensity <- function(plate, max_intensity_cutoff = 500) {
  plate %>%
    mutate(fail_intensity = max_intensity <= max_intensity_cutoff)
}

flag_perimeter <- function(plate, max_perimeter = 1000) {
  plate %>%
    mutate(fail_perimeter = perimeter >= max_perimeter)
}

apply_filters <- function(plate) {
  plate <- flag_size(plate)
  plate <- flag_edge(plate)
  plate <- flag_intensity(plate)
  plate <- flag_perimeter(plate)
  plate <- plate %>%
    group_by(image_name) %>%
    group_modify(~ flag_overlap_img(.x, radius = radius)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(pass_qc = !fail_size & !fail_edge & !fail_intensity & !fail_perimeter & !fail_overlap)

  n_total <- nrow(plate)
  n_pass  <- sum(plate$pass_qc)

  message(glue(
    "  Filtering summary:\n",
    "    Total:          {n_total}\n",
    "    Fail size:      {sum(plate$fail_size)}\n",
    "    Fail edge:      {sum(plate$fail_edge)}\n",
    "    Fail intensity: {sum(plate$fail_intensity)}\n",
    "    Fail perimeter: {sum(plate$fail_perimeter)}\n",
    "    Fail overlap:   {sum(plate$fail_overlap)}\n",
    "    Pass QC:        {n_pass} ({round(n_pass / n_total * 100, 1)}%)"
  ))

  plate
}

process_plate <- function(filename) {
  experiment_id <- str_extract(basename(filename), "^[^_]+")
  message("Processing: ", experiment_id)

  plate <- read_csv(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Folder_ID   = experiment_id,
      well_row    = as.integer(str_extract(image_name, "(?<=r)\\d+")),
      well_column = as.integer(str_extract(image_name, "(?<=c)\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    left_join(plateID_to_folder_ID, by = "Folder_ID") %>%
    left_join(samplesheet, by = c("well_row", "well_column", "iNDI_Plate_ID")) %>%
    apply_filters()

  message("  → Plate ID: ", unique(plate$iNDI_Plate_ID)[1], 
          " | n = ", nrow(plate), " | pass = ", sum(plate$pass_qc))

  plate
}

all_nuclei <- map(nuc_files, process_plate) %>%
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
#| label: Filter nuclei 
# that pass QC

good_nuclei <- all_nuclei %>%
  filter(pass_qc == TRUE) %>%
  select(
    Folder_ID,
    image_name,
    label
    )

# Apply to organelle data
message(glue("There are {nrow(df)} rows of organelle data"))

filtered_org <- df %>% 
  semi_join(
    good_nuclei,
    by = c(
      "Measurement_ID" = "Folder_ID",
      "DAPI_filename" = "image_name",
      "Nucleus_ID" = "label"
    )
  )

message(glue("There are {nrow(filtered_org)} rows of organelle data after filtering for nuclei that pass QC"))
```

```{r}
feature_cols <- c(
  "area_px", "coverage_frac", "organelle_count", "average_organelle_area",
  "max_f_intensity", "mean_f_intensity", "median_f_intensity",
  "CoefOfVar_intensity", "radial_mean", "radial_p25", "radial_p50",
  "radial_p75", "inner_frac", "mid_frac", "outer_frac", "boundary_touch_frac"
)

corrplot(cor(filtered_org[, feature_cols], use = "complete.obs"), 
         method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.7)

feature_cols <- c(
  "area_px", "organelle_count", "average_organelle_area", "mean_f_intensity", "CoefOfVar_intensity", "radial_mean"
)

corrplot(cor(filtered_org[, feature_cols], use = "complete.obs"), 
         method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.7)

set.seed(1)
n_sample <- 500 # subset 500 samples per genotype and structure

df_sub <- filtered_org %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(feature_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  group_by(iNDI_Plate_ID, Genotype_Name, Structure, experiment_design) %>%
  group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = min(n_sample, nrow(.x)))) %>%
  ungroup()

df %>% nrow
df_sub %>% nrow() 

df_sub %>% 
  group_by(iNDI_Plate_ID, Genotype_Name, Structure, experiment_design) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  filter(count < 500)

X     <- df_sub[, feature_cols]
X_sc  <- scale(X)
X_pca <- prcomp(X_sc, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)$x[, 1:min(8, ncol(X))]
umap_res <- umap(X_pca, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1)

df_sub <- df_sub %>%
  mutate(UMAP1 = umap_res[, 1],
         UMAP2 = umap_res[, 2])

#Plate UMAP
p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = iNDI_Plate_ID)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
ggsave("umap_PlateID.png", p, width = 12, height = 12)

# Experiment design UMAP
p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = experiment_design)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
ggsave("umap_Design.png", p, width = 12, height = 12)

# Structure UMAP
p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = Structure)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
ggsave("umap_Stain.png", p, width = 12, height = 12)

# Genotype UMAP
p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = Genotype_Name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = "none") 
ggsave("umap_Genotype.png", p, width = 12, height = 12)

p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = Genotype_Name)) +
  facet_wrap(~iNDI_Plate_ID) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(color = "none") 
ggsave("umap_Genotype_PlateID.png", p, width = 12, height = 12)
```

```{r}
plate_ids <- unique(df_sub$iNDI_Plate_ID)

walk(plate_ids, function(pid) {
  df_plate <- df_sub %>% filter(iNDI_Plate_ID == pid)
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plate, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
    geom_point(data = select(df_plate, -Genotype_Name), 
               color = "grey80", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Genotype_Name), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ Genotype_Name) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = pid) +
    guides(color = "none") 
  
  ggsave(glue("umap_{pid}.png"), p, width = 12, height = 12)
})
```
